name: answer_knowledge
description: Answer a factual or explanatory question that needs no live research or screen context.

name: research_topic
description: Research a topic using current external sources when the user explicitly asks to research, investigate, or find current information.

name: describe_screen
description: Describe or explain what is currently visible on the user's screen without taking an action.

name: perform_screen_action
description: Perform a specific, non-destructive action in the visible user interface.

name: route_to_phone_model
description: Route a request that needs the larger phone model because it requires broad synthesis or richer generation, but no screen action.
